capabilities: draw and edit circuit diagrams on a canvas
save and reuse nodes via a component library
sync a pre-built component library from GitHub
export the circuit as a PNG image
embed circuit files in notes and canvases
extras: Only online use is the Sync command, which downloads library.json from GitHub; the README states nothing is ever uploaded.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw circuit diagrams or display them inside notes and canvas cards.

relations.evidence: It is based on the code-forge-temple/circuit-sketcher-core.
we provide a curated library of circuit components at circuit-sketcher-lib

summary: Circuit diagram editor that draws, edits, saves, and embeds circuits as .circuit-sketcher files in notes and on Obsidian canvases.
